# Site fixture

A small, fixed results set used by the web unit and end-to-end tests, so
the tests do not depend on live data.

- `site/data/listings/2026-11-14.json` is a subset of the real snapshot of
  that date.
- `site/data/listings/2026-10-31.json` is a synthetic earlier snapshot made
  from the same subset with some listings removed and some prices changed.
  Its prices are test data, not research.
- `site/results/` was generated by the backend from those inputs:

  ```bash
  MVI_ROOT=apps/web/test/fixtures/site node apps/backend/dist/cli/main.js score --snapshot 2026-11-14
  ```

  and likewise `report`, and both again for `2026-10-31`.

The site builds against the fixture when `MVI_RESULTS_DIR` points at
`apps/web/test/fixtures/site/results`.
